title: How should student work be entered?
question: Taste templates are settled: not job titles, work-first, garden chrome stays on the dashboard. What should a visitor do inside a public folio?

options.label: Contact sheet
options.thesis: The page is a light table of student frames; the visitor reads the work as a numbered sequence.
options.viewport: A full-width strip of stills with the student’s name as a caption, not a resume hero.
options.risk: Can feel archival if the frames are too small to inhabit.

options.label: Critique pin-up
options.thesis: Pieces hang at mixed scale on a studio wall; the visitor walks the hang, then steps closer.
options.viewport: One large print and two smaller stills already on the wall; bio is a wall label.
options.risk: Reads as a mood board if the hang has no spatial logic.

options.label: Screening dailies
options.thesis: One piece owns the room; the next piece replaces it like a reel change.
options.viewport: A single still or clip fills the first viewport; name and taste sit as a title card overlay.
options.risk: Hides the body of work until the visitor clicks; internships may want more at a glance.
